style: Premium crisp arcade pixel-art sprite matching Neo Geo fighting game assets. Hard pixel clusters, dark purple outline, vibrant limited palette, clean readable silhouette, detailed but no photorealism, no blur. Single isolated subject with actual transparent background, no shadow, no ground, no text, no sheet, no extra objects. Full subject completely visible, strictly SIDE VIEW.
